verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports background automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows adjacent features: subscription payment plans and recurring payment links are domain-specific recurring billing, and webhooks are developer building blocks. Neither is a general capability for setting up autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
